name: Yorgen Farmstead
summary: Defias outlaws now occupy Yorgen Farmstead in southern Duskwood. The farm once belonged to Sven Yorgen, who fled north to a camp along the Darkened Bank.

sections.title: A Ruined Homestead
sections.body: Yorgen Farmstead lies in southern Duskwood, where Sven Yorgen once worked the land. Dangers drove Sven from his farm, and he retreated north to a makeshift camp along the Darkened Bank. Outlaws claimed the abandoned grounds, seeking a foothold beyond the reach of Stormwind's authorities.

sections.title: Defias Infiltration
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood now uses Yorgen Farmstead as a staging ground. Masked highwaymen and cutthroats hide among the decaying fences and weathered outbuildings, screened by dense trees. Defias assassins patrol the perimeter and ambush travelers who trespass on the seized property.

faq.answer: Sven Yorgen once owned and farmed Yorgen Farmstead. Rising dangers drove him from his home to a solitary camp farther north along the Darkened Bank.
The Defias Brotherhood occupies the deserted farm. Cutpurses, bandits, and hidden assassins prowl its overgrown yards and barnyards, making a visit dangerous.
Sven Yorgen left the farm for a modest camp along the Darkened Bank, north of Yorgen Farmstead beside the river between Duskwood and Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why is the Defias Brotherhood in Duskwood?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood has carried its operations far beyond Westfall. Disorganized rural settlements and weakened regional defenses let its agents establish hidden camps and strongholds beyond the reach of Stormwind's marshals.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can see how Defias assassins use the neglected farmstead as a concealed hideout.
As an Alliance member, you can see how far the Defias Brotherhood has spread through Duskwood while the Night Watch struggles to keep order in Darkshire.
